storylines.description: The video discusses the advancements in AI, particularly the development of transformers in 2017. The narrator highlights several emergent behaviors of AI models, such as the ability to explain jokes, play chess, and perform sentiment analysis. The conversation then shifts towards the potential connection between these emergent behaviors and artificial general intelligence (AGI), raising questions about the ethical implications and the need for transparency in AI development.

youtube_description:
I remember seeing a video on YouTube a number of years ago in which a very compelling 'insider' demonstrated that the singularity had already happened. That video is now no longer available, or at least I couldn't find it for the life of me.

[Remix and clipping encouraged - find something in the episode that interests you and comment]

Now listening to Tristan Harris and Aza Raskin here, the co-founders of the Center for Humane Technology (a great podcast BTW) I'm starting to suspect that the reality is slowly being leaked.

When I hear people say of AI "It's just a prediction tool, it's just learning what the next word is going to be". I can't believe their ignorance.

Listen to this and let me know what you think?

You can listen to the full episode here:

https://www.dailymotion.com/video/x8qq89i

Or listen to the Center for Human Technology Podcast here:

https://www.humanetech.com/podcast
